newsitem.title: USA: Signature Resorts to buy AVCOM for $28 million.
newsitem.headline: Signature Resorts to buy AVCOM for $28 million.

text.p: Signature Resorts Inc., an operator of timeshare resorts, said Monday it agreed to acquire AVCOM International Inc., the parent company of All Seasons Resorts Inc., for $28.8 million in stock and the assumption of debt.
AVCOM operates timeshare resorts in Arizona, California and Texas.
Following the news, Signature's stock jumped $1 to $21.25 while AVCOM rose 87.5 cents at $4.75, both on the Nasdaq market.
Under the merger agreement, Signature Resorts said it agreed to issue 1.48 million shares of common stock in exchange for all of the outstanding AVCOM stock.
Signature also said it will assume $22.6 million of AVCOM's existing debt.

"All Seasons represents a strong compliment to our existing resort portfolio and operations. We believe All Seasons will significantly expand our ownership and resort base in the West," said Andrew Gessow, president of Signature Resorts.
